subject: Hydrangea SIG intake — scheduling and Q&A summary
messages:
From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@hydrangea.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@hydrangea.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Hydrangea SIG intake — scheduling and initial questions

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to kick off the SIG/CAIQ intake for Hydrangea Therapeutics and would like to schedule the initial call to review the questionnaire and evidence handoff process. Our goals for the call: align on scope (CAIQ + selected SIG modules), confirm artifact formats (logs, config screenshots), and agree on timelines.

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed Aug 18, 10:00–10:45
- Thu Aug 19, 14:00–14:45

I've attached our initial Q&A workbook with a few prefilled entries (hydrangea-initial-qna.xlsx). A couple of things we want to confirm ahead of the call:
- Which log types do you accept for KV/cache and inference telemetry? (syslog vs. compressed JSON export)
- What's the recommended way to share sample tokenized logs without exposing PHI?
- Do you have a preferred encryption key custody model (Redwood KMS vs. customer-managed keys)?

Attaching: hydrangea-initial-qna.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to locking a slot.

Best,
Alyssa Nguyen
Head of Security Programs
Hydrangea Therapeutics
alyssa@hydrangea.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@hydrangea.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hydrangea SIG intake — scheduling and initial questions

Hi Alyssa — thanks for sending this over. Either proposed slot works for our team; can we lock Wed Aug 18 at 10:00 PT? I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Quick prep items for the meeting:
- Ben (cc) will own the evidence mapping and can talk through accepted log export formats (we typically accept compressed JSON exports and Parquet; syslog is OK if it's time-indexed).
- Jonas (cc) will cover CAIQ module scoping and sample artifacts.
- Please put any sensitive redactions in a separate zipped file and mark which fields are redacted; we can accept tokenized samples if you replace PHI with consistent placeholders.

We use a mix of Redwood-managed KMS and customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) depending on Private deployment. For the intake call we can outline options and provide our KMS architecture doc (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).

I'll attach the Redwood intake checklist and a short link to our Drive with sample artifact templates.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf; link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Hygndx-hydrangea-sig

If that all sounds good, confirm Wed 8/18 and we'll circulate a calendar invite with dial-in.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance (Solutions)
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@hydrangea.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hydrangea SIG intake — scheduling and initial questions

Alyssa — quick note before the call:
- Preferred log flavors: compressed JSON exports (gz/ndjson) are easiest for our tooling. If you must send syslog, include a timestamp index and timezone.
- Retention clarification: for the SIG we typically request a 90-day window of inference logs plus a 1-year window for system audit logs. If you have a shorter retention policy, flag it and we'll document scope limitations.

I'll prepare a short runbook showing the exact fields we typically ask for (request_id, model_id, timestamp, token_count, latencies).

—Ben
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@hydrangea.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@hydrangea.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hydrangea SIG intake — scheduling and initial questions

Thanks — Wed 8/18 10:00 PT works for us. Please send the invite.

A couple of attachments we'll bring to the call:
- preliminary SOC 2 bridge document (we'll share the PDF during the call)
- list of servers and owners (we'll attach after call)

One clarifying question on keys: Hydrangea currently uses a customer-managed key in GCP KMS for production. For the SIG, do you need evidence of key lifecycle procedures (rotation frequency, access control audit logs)? Or is a policy excerpt sufficient initially?

Also looping Sean O'Leary (IT Ops) for any constraints on log extraction windows.

Best,
Alyssa

On Wed, Aug 12, 2026 at 9:14 AM Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa@hydrangea.com> wrote:

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Hydrangea SIG intake — meeting notes, Q&A, and action items

Hi Alyssa, Priya, Sean — thanks again for the call today. Notes and next steps below.

Meeting summary:
- Scope agreed: CAIQ full profile + SIG (inference telemetry, data residency) — see attached action grid.
- Artifacts requested: 90-day inference logs (ndjson/gz), 1-year system/audit logs, KMS policy excerpt, network diagram (VPC/subnets), and a current SOC 2 report (redacted where needed).
- Redaction approach: use consistent placeholders for PHI in sample logs; provide a redaction manifest (column-level mapping).

Clarifying Q&A captured:
Q1: Do you need evidence of key rotation events?
A1: Yes — rotation cadence and a single rotation event audit log is preferred. Provide policy excerpt + one audit record.

Q2: Can logs be delivered via secure SFTP or do you prefer Drive transfer?
A2: Either is fine; for larger exports we prefer SFTP. We'll share an upload endpoint if needed.

Action items (owner — due):
- Hydrangea: Provide redacted sample of 7 days of inference logs (Priya Shah) — due 2026-08-25
- Hydrangea: Share KMS policy excerpt and one rotation audit record (Alyssa) — due 2026-08-26
- Redwood: Provide evidence runbook and field mapping template (Ben Carter) — due 2026-08-20
- Redwood: Upload intake artifact checklist and CAIQ mapping (Monica Patel) — done (link above)

Attachments transferred after call: hydrangea-prelim-soc2.pdf (redacted), hydrangea-initial-qna.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf. Recording: call-recording-20260818.mp4 (internal link).

If any of this needs correction, flag by EOD tomorrow. Otherwise we'll treat the action items as agreed and follow up on the due dates above.

Thanks again — I'll follow up with a single-thread summary for your procurement contact if needed.

Best,
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance (Solutions)
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
